title: TVP: TV is Almost All You Need for Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.00588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference with a drafter whose proposed tokens are verified by the target model in parallel. Under lossless speculative sampling, a draft token is accepted with probability one minus the total variation (TV) distance between the target and draft distributions, yet drafters are often trained with cross-entropy (CE) or KL. We first show that under matched and well-tuned training, TV matches or surpasses several published draft-training objectives when fine-tuning, and a fixed TV and KL mixture does the same when training from scratch. We identify two remaining problems, TV's vanishing gradients on undercovered tokens and the prefix products that starve later positions in acceptance-length objectives. To address both, we derive TVP, a loss family based on expected acceptance length, whose power parameter interpolates between coverage and acceptance oriented objectives. translated_title: TVP：对投机解码而言，总变差几乎就是你所需要的一切
translated_abstract: 投机解码通过一个起草模型加速大语言模型推理，起草模型提出的token由目标模型并行验证。在无损投机采样下，一个草稿token被接受的概率等于1减去目标分布与草稿分布之间的总变差（TV）距离，然而起草模型通常却使用交叉熵（CE）或KL散度进行训练。我们首先证明，在匹配且经过良好调优的训练条件下，TV在微调场景下能够匹敌或超越几种已发表的草稿训练目标；而在从零训练场景下，固定的TV与KL混合目标同样能做到这一点。我们还识别出两个仍然存在的问题：TV在覆盖不足的token上会出现梯度消失，以及接受长度目标中的前缀乘积会导致后面的位置“饥饿”。为同时解决这两个问题，我们推导出TVP，一个基于期望接受长度的损失函数族，其幂参数可在覆盖导向与接受导向的目标之间进行插值。将幂参数从零退火至某一值，能够……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文证明总变差（TV）距离在草稿模型训练中匹敌或超越已有目标，并提出基于期望接受长度的TVP损失函数族，通过幂参数插值解决梯度消失与后位置饥饿问题，从而提升投机解码性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that total variation (TV) distance matches or surpasses existing draft-training objectives for speculative decoding, and proposes TVP, a loss family based on expected acceptance length that interpolates between coverage and acceptance oriented objectives to address vanishing gradients and position starvation.
